name: Tesla Kubernetes Breach
desc: A cryptomining attack discovered on a Tesla kubernetes (k8s) cluster.

acts.d: The adversary sets up server[s] to run a cryptomining pool.
The adversary proxies their mining pool through Cloudflare CDN.
The adversary proxies their mining pool through Cloudflare CDN.
The adversary runs cryptomining software in the container, configured to use their private mining pool.
The adversary logs into the Kubernetes console.
The adversary can view plaintext AWS keys in the Kubernetes console.
The adversary authenticates to AWS S3 using the discovered credentials.
The adversary can access data in private S3 buckets.
The adversary deploys a new container on the Kubernetes cluster.
